name.value: The Hidden Gem Treat Shop & Cafe

description.value: The Hidden Gem is a plant-based cafe, bakery, and ice creamery tucked into Cook Street Village in Victoria, specializing in house-made vegan and dairy-free treats including patisserie, specialty coffees, and plant-based ice cream. The cafe has a garden seating area and caters to a wide range of dietary needs including gluten-free and nut-free options. It sits in a walkable neighbourhood close to Dallas Road beaches, making it a natural stop for cyclists exploring the area.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 64m; staple (4 spaces) at 72m; staple (4 spaces) at 95m. Total: 8 spaces.
